EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2878 and 2952 cm⁻¹ and a CH₂/CH₃ deformation near 1450 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003), indicating a saturated hydrocarbon backbone. A strong band at ~923 cm⁻¹ together with a C–O-related feature near 1057 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a five-membered cyclic ether (THF-type ring breathing and C–O stretch), which fits OCC1CCCO1. Candidates lacking a cyclic ether ring or with only open-chain ether/amine motifs are less compatible with the prominent ~923 cm⁻¹ band.
